preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 5 * 10**5 for N, c, points in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of points N is between 1 and 500,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 < c <= 10**9 for N, c, points in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the integer c is between 1 and 1,000,000,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(-10**9 <= x <= 10**9 and -10**9 <= y <= 10**9 for x, y in points) for N, c, points in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, each point (x_i, y_i) has coordinates between -1,000,000,000 and 1,000,000,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: sum(N for N, c, points in test_cases) <= 5 * 10**5
preconditions.description: The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 500,000.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(checkpoints, int) and isinstance(moves, int) for checkpoints, moves in results)
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output consists of two integers: the minimum number of checkpoints and the minimum number of moves.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= checkpoints <= N for checkpoints, moves, (N, c, points) in zip(results, test_cases))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the minimum number of checkpoints is between 1 and N inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(moves >= 0 for checkpoints, moves in results)
postconditions.description: For each test case, the minimum number of moves is non-negative.
